status_summary: OPM awarded Oracle the Federal HRIT Modernization Core Human Capital Management contract, reported as awarded on 2026-06-10, for a single governmentwide HR platform to replace the more than 100 Core HCM systems agencies use, to be implemented in phases. Trade reports put the contract at nearly $400 million, one report gives a term of up to 10 years, and MeriTalk lists VA among eight first-wave agencies beginning the transition in FY2026, with governmentwide adoption targeted for FY2028. This is an OPM-led route rather than the VA acquisition the text describes, and no VA-specific migration schedule, contract or go-live date was found.

timeline.event: OPM awarded Oracle the Federal HRIT Modernization Core Human Capital Management contract for a single governmentwide HR platform to be implemented in phases (award date from news reports; the OPM release is undated).

title: Acquire a new human resources IT system for VA
uncertainties: The OPM release was read on opm.gov in review on 2026-10-18; it carries no date, contract value, wave schedule or agency list and does not mention VA, and the 2026-06-10 date comes from the opm.gov release listing read by the researcher and from MeriTalk. MeriTalk (2026-06-11) was read in review and lists VA in Wave 1 but gives no contract term; the up-to-10-year term comes from a GovConWire report that was not reopened. Whether the platform replaces VA's HR Smart system was not confirmed; a further web search by the researcher returned only older VA market research items. VA published market research for its own cloud HCM platform in November 2024, before the period. No VA or OPM document with a VA migration schedule was found.
